title: A Worm With No Mouth or Stomach Eats Whale Bones With Acid

scenes.text: A worm with no mouth eats whale bones.
Scientists first found it on a dead whale nearly three kilometres down off California.
It's called Osedax. It has no mouth, no stomach, no eyes.
Root-like tissue grows into the bone and releases acid to dissolve it.
Bacteria living inside help break down the fats and collagen.
And each female carries dozens of tiny males inside her body.

description:
A worm with no mouth eats whale bones.
Osedax worms use root-like tissue and acid to dig into bone, with help from bacteria inside them.
What is the strangest animal you have ever heard of?
first_comment: Which is weirder: a worm with no mouth, or a crab that farms its own food?
